title: Deport All Illegals (Bonus Edition) | Change My Mind
description:
Steven Crowder is at the University of Oklahoma’s campus with another student for a bonus conversation about what it actually means to be an American. They cover everything from the cost of illegal immigration, remittances, and H-1B visas to assimilation, shared language, and whether someone can be “more” or “less” American based on their values.

Link to today’s sources: https://www.louderwithcrowder.com/cmm-deport-all-illegals

Deport All Illegals (Part 1) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hVaFNtoPnz4&t=221s
End All SNAP Benefits https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wsngJ3xV56U&t=1486s

comments.text: It’s remarkable how many people misunderstand the term “melting pot”. In a pot of melted ingredients, they become one; they don’t stay separated or disjointed. So yes, buying into the American dream and into the values that make our country successful should be a foundational expectation for all citizens. It was intentional that the nation’s motto was written as “E Pluribus Unum”, not “E Pluribus Multis”. Together we are stronger, and we are intended to grow together as one in the eyes of our founding fathers. This has been bastardized into the belief that being one means we are resistant to change. No, we are resistant to the destruction of what currently makes our nation great. If you can change our country for the better, convince us all how and we will all do it together.
